page.overview:
Who is Enrique Cardoso?

Enrique Cardoso was a Costa Rican boat captain who operated an illegal parasailing trip around Isla Sorna called Dino-Soar.

While giving an illegal tour of Isla Sorna to Ben Hildebrand and Eric Kirby, he and his co-captain mysteriously disappeared as the boat passed through a thick fog. Earlier scripts showed that a flock of Pteranodons killed them, likely the ones roaming freely in .

The boat then crashed into some rocks, but not before Ben and Eric were able to detach their sail from the boat and fly freely onto the island.
